evidence: We adopted zinc acetate (Zn(CH3COO)2) and water vapor suitable for LT ZnO growth. Initial Mn doping was done using 2,2,6,6-tetramethyl-3,5-heptanedione (Mn(thd)3), used previously for Mn doping of ZnMnS. In further growth processes we used tris(2,4-pentanedionato)manganese(III) (Mn(acac)3). ... In ALD precursors are alternatively introduced into a growth chamber separated by purging periods with a neutral gas (nitrogen in the present study), which allows use of reactive precursors, since they meet only at a surface of a grown film.
